objective: Seed golden RAG questions, run deterministic RAG evaluation against the live answer path, persist eval runs/results, and write evidence that exposes regressions and failure categories.
deliverables: Added lib/rag/evals.ts with 50 golden questions across onboarding, content engine, quiz/challenge/points, premium, and RAG/AI/build education.
Added deterministic scoring for retrieval hit rate, citation coverage, context precision, faithfulness, groundedness, answer usefulness, and refusal correctness hooks.
Added scripts/rag/evaluate-rag.ts to seed rag_eval_questions, create rag_eval_runs, persist rag_eval_results, and write evidence JSON.
Added npm scripts rag:evaluate and rag:evaluate:smoke.
Added unit coverage for golden-set integrity and pass/fail scoring behavior.
Ran smoke eval and full 50-question live eval through the real answerRagQuestion path.

commands.notes: tsc --noEmit passed after final eval changes.
Next build completed. Existing academy dynamic-server-usage warnings appeared and did not fail the build.

honestResult.reason: The final full eval passed exactly at the 70% pass-rate threshold. This is enough to make regressions measurable, but not enough to call RAG world-class.
honestResult.failurePattern: Failures are concentrated around command/content/reputation questions that should retrieve Discord runbook/community docs but often miss the expected source. This points to retrieval/reranking/query rewriting work, not only generation quality.

notYetDone: No admin UI section exists for eval summaries or failed eval drilldown.
No model-based judge or RAGAS/DeepEval integration exists yet.
The eval corpus is seeded and useful, but the system is not high-scoring yet: 15 of 50 evals still fail.
nextPhase: Phase 3 - retrieval upgrade with query rewriting, reranking, before/after eval comparison, and a materially higher pass rate target.
